scene: Inside the repair shed, whirring clockwork toys clutter workbenches beneath hanging lanterns.
picture: Flat side view inside the bustling workshop. On the far left sits a workbench loaded with gears and a wound brass frog. Left of centre, the grandfather stands holding his bicycle with crate plants. In the centre, a badger mechanic in goggles works at an anvil. Far right, a wooden roll-up shutter stays shut.
shown: a key sticking out of a chunky brass frog toy on the left workbench
a friendly badger mechanic in leather goggles standing in the centre behind an anvil
a rolled-down wooden slatted shutter set into the far right workshop wall
